static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.occupation: 准备参加Lawyer资格考试的Graduated from law school生(立志成为Lawyer)
static_traits.social_status: Has a stable support system composed of parents, but because of inferiority avoids socializing with law school friends and colleagues
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;在多次司法考试失败前without类似心理问题史;not yet接受过其他心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性Good,能具体描述创伤事件与情绪体验;对咨询持积极态度,配合度高;倾向自责与标签化表达(如'我太笨了')

basic_info.main_problem: 在多次司法考试失败后感到自己without能,怀疑without法成为一名成功的Lawyer.
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的without能感和Self-doubt显著影响了我的身心健康和继续从事法律职业的动力,这促使我寻求咨询;我not想再被这种Fear控制.我只是想像以前一样再次享受这项运动.
growth_experiences: 原生家庭职业背景:父母均为资深Lawyer,without兄弟姐妹;在职业选择与成就上长期感到需要达到父母的成功标准,由此形成显著的压力与比较.
第一次司法考试失败后开始出现强烈的without能感和Self-doubt;随后多次失败进一步Reinforcement这种体验;每当想到Lawyer职业,尤其在与父母的成功对照时,该感受显著加剧,影响Learning动机与日常功能.
约一年前在打垒球时被球击中,经历剧烈疼痛与惊吓;自此将垒球与受伤联结,看到电视上的垒球比赛或听朋友谈论垒球会唤起Anxiety,并完全回避参与该运动.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough / not competent enough(I am incompetent)
Only by reaching my parents' standard of success am I worthy

special_situations.event: 收到司法考试再次not yet通过的成绩通知
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果多次not yet通过,就证明I am not smart enough,永远not可能成为Lawyer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更换Learning方法,报名not同的备考课程,加倍Learning以弥补'not足'

special_situations.event: Talking with parents about career or thinking of parents' success
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到父母的成就,就会让他们失望,说明我not用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免与父母讨论not安和失败,把压力埋在心里
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I let them down/我not如他们

special_situations.event: When facing socializing with law school friends/colleagues or hearing them talk about work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not如同侪,就是失败和丢脸
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing with classmates and colleagues to reduce being compared and evaluated

special_situations.event: Sees a softball game on TV or is invited to play softball
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I participate in softball again, injury will definitely happen again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoids softball-related situations and activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会上场就受伤,not值得冒险

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被父母认可与看见为有能力的人,证明自己可以胜任Lawyer职业并被接纳
core_conflict.fear: Fears the shame of failure and being belittled; in sports, fears being injured again and losing control
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与回避比较来降低羞耻与被deny的风险
not向父母表达脆弱以维持自尊与表面稳定

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的,随时可能被评判为失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Parents/peers are authorities with high standards, judgment, and comparison

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当与父母或他人谈及司法考试失利与Career development时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方体验为评判者,认为自己会被看作not够好(移情:被评判)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以事实性,简短的回答回避情感表达,快速Displacement话题,降低目光接触.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or reminded to join softball activities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others ignore risks; if one participates, one will definitely be injured
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use理性化措辞(如'风险/成本not成比例')礼貌而坚定地拒绝.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当看到同侪的职业进展并not由自主地进行比较时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把挫折理解为自身核心缺陷,认为一切都是'我not行'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与绝对化语言(如'都是我not好'),降低自我肯定与求助意愿.

manifestations: Avoids socializing with law-school friends and colleagues
难以与父母讨论without能感与Self-doubt
Uses parents' success standards as the benchmark for self-worth, limiting room for choice
Fear of failure makes choices in career and leisure activities more constricted (avoiding social situations of retaking exams, avoiding softball)
outcomes: 内在冲突与Increased anxiety,行动受阻

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes parents' success standards into the 'must / should' for evaluating herself, equating whether she passes exams with self-worth
On career topics, evaluates oneself by a success/failure dichotomy

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁use自责与标签化语言(如'我太笨了')
在关系与社交中过度担心他人评价而Withdrawal

exception_events.target_problem: 在接触或想到垒球相关线索时,Li Mei通常会出现强烈的Anxiety并选择回避该运动.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在专注于Work或其他爱好时,Fear感明显减弱,have not像往常那样被与垒球相关的Anxiety所控制.
exception_events.reason: 线索:注意力被其他任务占据,情境关注点Displacement,降低了对受伤记忆的唤起与威胁评估,从而Fear减轻.

positive_force: Family support system stable (parents can provide resources and support)
能坚持多次尝试not同备考方法与课程,具有一定毅力
Rationally knows injury is not inevitable (experience of playing safely for many past years)
在注意力Displacement时Anxiety可显著下降,说明存在自我调节的潜在能力
negative_force: 深层的'I am not smart enough/not如父母'的核心信念与自我标签化
Tendency toward external comparison and seeking external validation, overly concerned with comparisons to parents and peers
回避策略(Avoids socializing与回避垒球)产生负Reinforcement,维持问题
灾难化与预测not yet来的认知偏差(如'我一定会再次受伤''我not可能通过考试')
自我批评与Self-denial导致动机与Daily functioning declining

target_behavior.behavior: Fear of and avoidance of softball
antecedent: Seeing or thinking of a softball game (e.g. on television)
Friends talking about or inviting one to play softball
Recalling the pain and fright of being hit by a ball
target_behavior.core_reason: Associative learning after traumatic pain and fright, forming the catastrophic and predictive belief 're-engaging = will definitely be injured'
target_behavior.function: 逃避感知的危险与由此带来的Anxiety,短期降低not适
target_behavior.consequence: without法参与原本喜爱的运动,Depression与失落增加,Fear被维持和Reinforcement

antecedent: Talking about the bar exam or the legal profession
target_behavior.core_reason: 失败后的羞耻与Self-doubt,担心被负面评价(个人化,比较与despair)
target_behavior.function: 逃避被比较与被评判以降低羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support,Increased sense of isolation,Negative self-evaluation得以维持

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation的负性Automatic thoughts(如'我太笨了''我not可能通过')
antecedent: Receiving news of or thinking about failing the bar exam
When planning or preparing to retake an exam
When comparing oneself with parents and peers in evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: 'I am not smart enough/without能'的核心信念与过度概括,预测not yet来等认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 通过降低期望来避免再次失败带来的强烈失落与羞耻(短期Self-protection)
target_behavior.consequence: Learning动机与Decreased efficiency,Career development受阻,抑郁与Anxiety情绪加重
